limits: The combined profile runs stock .NET SDK 10.0.403 on one native macOS ARM64 server with PostgreSQL 16.16 and isolated loopback HTTP. Ordered groups use whole package ID ownership, current proxy absence, mixed source dependencies, separate same-coordinate application bytes, namespace ownership, review, grants and restart. Independent remote feeds, group registration and search, other clients, production TLS and larger workloads remain open.
